curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover dark pedestrian signals, then what pedestrians should do to stay safe when crossing.
Teach leaving an alley or driveway, yielding on left turns, and when a U-turn is allowed.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each turning rule; contrast cards for driveway versus left-turn yielding and the U-turn conditions.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions about driveways, left turns and U-turns.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain the Defensive Driving Program, Traffic Survival School, points, paying a fine and the penalties for injury or death crashes.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each penalty rule; contrast cards for school versus suspension and the two crash penalties.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions about what follows a red-light conviction.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach yielding to emergency vehicles on ordinary roads and four-lane highways, following distances and stopped emergency scenes.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; contrast cards for the two following distances and the two yielding methods.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions about pulling over and following distances.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain the move-over law, what it covers and where, then yielding to funeral processions.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; contrast cards for moving over versus slowing down.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions about passing a vehicle stopped with flashing lights.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach stopping for a loading school bus, when you may go, the divided roadway exception and obeying speed rules.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each school bus rule; contrast cards for the release signals and divided roadways.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions about school buses on divided and undivided roads.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec10-m01..sec10-m06; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact

domain_emphasis_check.domain: Pedestrian safety, alleys and driveways, left turns and U-turns, red-light penalties, emergency vehicles, the move-over law, funerals and school buses
Yield, emergency-vehicle, red-light-penalty and school-bus confusables

sequencing.rule: module order, then component facts before synthesis nodes
